items.summary: Fix production deep-link routing so visiting https://vpn-time-unlock.caffeine.xyz/admin loads the React SPA and renders the Admin Panel (instead of a black screen saying “Publish or restore your app”). Implement a static hosting-safe solution that does not rely on server rewrites (e.g., provide an /admin entry HTML that bootstraps the same app).

Ensure the Admin Panel dashboard UI renders and exposes the two requested sections for authenticated admins: (1) AdMob Settings (App ID + Rewarded Ad Unit ID with save) and (2) User Stats (users & sessions overview table). Add a clear in-UI error state if any of the admin queries fail so the page never appears as a blank/black screen.
